_comment: Giai đoạn 3 (i18n) — bảng dịch error_code sang tiếng Anh. Đợt 1: nhóm auth/token/account (ưu tiên cao nhất). Đợt 2: nhóm not_found/required tĩnh của job/company/contact (ưu tiên thứ 2 — CRUD người dùng thao tác thường xuyên). error_code KHÔNG có ở đây sẽ tự fallback về message tiếng Việt gốc từ backend (xem resolveErrorMessage() trong src/lib/api/client.ts), không bao giờ vỡ UI. Không đưa vào đây các error_code có nội dung động (UUID/giá trị nhập sai, số lần thử, danh sách hợp lệ...) vì message thật đã được backend chèn giá trị runtime vào (f-string) — dịch tĩnh sẽ làm mất thông tin đó; nhóm này để dịch sau khi có cơ chế template biến số.
token_expired: Access token is invalid or has expired — use the refresh token via POST /auth/refresh to get a new one.
session_revoked: This session is no longer valid — please log in again.
session_replaced: This account just logged in from another location — the current session has been logged out. Each account can only be used in one place at a time.
auth_server_chua_cau_hinh_api: The server is not configured with an API_KEY — see .env.example.
auth_missing: Missing or invalid API key. Send it via the 'X-API-Key' header.
auth_email_not_verified: Email not verified yet — check your inbox or call POST /auth/resend-verification to resend the verification link.
auth_locked: Account temporarily locked due to too many consecutive failed logins — please try again in a few minutes.
auth_refresh_token_thu_hoi_truoc: This refresh token has already been revoked — for security, all sessions for this account have been logged out. Please log in again.
auth_expired_2: Refresh token has expired — please log in again.
auth_deactivated_2: This account is no longer active.
auth_email_tai_khoan: This email already has an account.
auth_invalid: The password reset link is invalid or has already been used.
auth_expired: The password reset link has expired — call POST /auth/forgot-password again to get a new one.
user_email_tai_khoan: This email already has an account.
user_role_1_user_ss_team: Role must be one of: user, ss_team, admin.
user_forbidden: You can't change your own role — ask another admin to do this.
user_forbidden_2: You can't deactivate/activate your own account — ask another admin to do this.
contact_assigned_ss_user_tai_khoan: assigned_ss_user must be an account with role 'ss_team' or 'admin' — a contact cannot be assigned to a 'user' (student) account.
contact_company_not_found_2: No contact found under this company
contact_required: Editing an HR contact requires a 'note' explaining the reason for the change (field 'note' in the body) — other SS-team members need to know why this contact's info changed.
contact_required_2: Assigning/changing/unassigning the HR contact owner requires a 'note' explaining the reason — other SS-team members need to know why.
contact_still_active: This contact is still active — soft-delete it (DELETE /companies/{company_id}/contacts/{contact_id}) before hard-deleting.
audit_log_nguoi_thuc_hien_thao_tac: Only the user who performed this action can edit its log note.
audit_log_required: This log requires a note — it cannot be left empty.
company_ma_so_thue_dung_boi: This tax ID is already used by another company.
contact_has_links: Cannot delete this contact because it still has linked data.
email_template_required: Editing an email template requires a 'note' explaining the reason for the change — other ss_team members need to know why the template content changed.
import_entity_type_job_filter_is: entity_type 'job' does not support the is_active filter.
import_entity_type_company_filter_compan: entity_type 'company' does not support the company_id filter (company exports itself).
import_unsupported_file_format_please_up: Unsupported file format. Please upload CSV or XLSX.
import_file_exceeds_maximum_of_5000: File exceeds the maximum of 5000 rows.
import_preview_expired_please_re_upload: Preview expired, please re-upload the file.
maintenance_already_active: A maintenance run is already active.
profile_ban_ung_tuyen_job_roi: You have already applied to this job.
profile_hoc_vien_chua_nop_cv: The student has not submitted a CV for this application.
profile_cannot_create: Unable to create a download link right now.
profile_ban_chua_ung_tuyen_job: You have not applied to this job.
profile_job_luu_roi: This job has already been saved.
profile_job_chua_luu: This job has not been saved.
message_ban_chan_nhan_tin_nguoi: You have been blocked from messaging this person.
message_yeu_cau_nhan_tin_ss: The messaging request is awaiting SS response.
message_ban_chan_hoc_vien_bam: You have blocked this student — click Unblock before messaging again.
message_ss_admin_moi_xem_danh: Only SS/admin can view the request list.
message_hoc_vien_moi_huy_yeu: Only the student can cancel their own messaging request.
message_not_found_2: No pending request found to cancel.
message_yeu_cau_vua_xu_ly: This request has just been processed (SS may have already responded) — please reload.
message_not_found_3: Cannot accept — the request does not exist, does not belong to you, or has already been processed by another action.
message_not_found_4: Cannot reject — the request does not exist, does not belong to you, or has already been processed by another action.
message_relationship_not_found: This relationship was not found, or does not belong to you.
message_relationship_not_found_2: Cannot unblock — the relationship does not exist, does not belong to you, or is not currently blocked.
import_internal_error: Import failed due to a database error.
